## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `./build-release.sh` passes.
- [ ] A staging Zimbra/Nextcloud end-to-end test was run, or the reason it was not run is documented.
- [ ] All visible strings are translated in all eleven locale dictionaries.
- [ ] No credentials, production URLs, private infrastructure details, encrypted profiles or customer data are included.
- [ ] Security, migration, restart and compatibility impacts are documented.

## Environment

List sanitized Zimbra, Nextcloud, office connector/Document Server and browser versions used for testing.
